name: Fiber Uppercut — Jai's birthday (example)
subject: It's Jai's birthday! Celebrate with Fiber Uppercut
preheader: Jai the black lab turns another year older on November 15.

data.headline: Happy birthday, Jai!
data.image_alt: Jai, a happy black lab, wearing a party hat

data.heading: Join the party
data.body:
Jai the black lab turns another year older on November 15, and we're celebrating with the best treat we know: a happy gut. Fiber Uppercut is a once-a-day powder that mixes into water, smoothies or coffee in seconds. Citrus-peach flavor, no grit, no gluten.

Mix one scoop with 8 oz of liquid. Stir, sip, done.

Try it for $10.
